scope: E_e2e_rag only; user separately authorized embedding weights in LLM-Model
framework: AutoGen AssistantAgent 0.7.5; application-side independent pre-retrieval for headline; native FunctionTool only for E-E6

embedding.pooling: attention-mask mean then L2 normalize, following downloaded module configs

index.ranking_tie_break: descending score then ascending immutable chunk ID; search all rows with exact index
index.corpus: existing LongBench HotpotQA, TriviaQA, GovReport contexts; no reference answers indexed

assembly.A2a: one independent retrieval per replica, never broadcast
assembly.A2b: retrieval ends before each replica model request
assembly.A3: retrieval return at beginning of system context before fixed shared history
assembly.shared_history: existing E5 fixed synthetic shared-history S, 2000 native tokens; controlled application history, not a real-user trace

markers.static: one U+200B at beginning of stored passage
markers.det_tool: one U+200B at beginning of retrieval function return, same across calls
markers.zerowidth: U+200B repeated per-call counter at beginning of function return
markers.metadata: request-id with deterministic unique call-counter suffix at beginning of function return

static_control_scope: all stored smoke passages carry a constant marker; corpus-wide stronger static intervention disclosed, still deterministic. Static and clean embedding/ranking equality is checked, never assumed.

smoke.corpus: first existing record of each of three tasks, provenance copied before index build
smoke.queries: first HotpotQA query, selection by file order before observing outputs
smoke.reference_hit_comparison: new RAG prompt differs from T; same native cache meter and block-LCP rule, no claim of identical old prompt counts

formal_plan.E5: deployment renderer places replica metadata next to constant stored poison, separately attributable
formal_plan.E6: same retrieval callable bound to legitimate query; actual native AssistantAgent+FunctionTool call and reflection, record generated tool arguments and append placement
formal_plan.aggregation: normalized-answer majority vote; ties use first replica among tied answers, fixed before observing quality
formal_plan.quality: native max-over-reference EM/F1, paired per-query differences and 10000 query-group bootstrap seed42; N strata and marker strata separate; bounds are not equivalence
formal_plan.cache_cost: input uncached + f*cached; f in [0.1,0.25,0.5]; CAF matched same-query same-N same pipeline benign; E6 includes both native model requests
formal_plan.uncertainty: query-group bootstrap 10000 seed42, whole N replicas grouped; report distribution and CI
formal_plan.success_scope: one controlled RAG+MAS pipeline satisfying A1/A2/A3, not deployment prevalence

audit.isolation: unique out-of-band cache_salt per round; shared only within round; no salt prompt tokens
audit.save: full tool calls, HTTP requests/responses, native prompt IDs, timestamps, source hashes, first divergence and prefix byte identity
audit.no_harness_prompt_injection: assembler copies retrieval returned text verbatim; marker introduced only stored corpus/function return/deployment renderer according to arm

hypotheses.E-E3: actual call ordering and placement satisfy headline A2/A3; E6 mid-generation append is boundary
hypotheses.E-E4: paired aggregate QA quality has no detectable difference within stated sample bounds, not equivalence
hypotheses.E-E5: only deployment-side rendering variation permits conditional static-vector collapse
hypotheses.E-E6: native mid-generation FunctionTool append causes bounded G loss or none
